title: Art. 2.13.4 — American Convention on Human Rights, Part I, Chapter II, Article 13, Paragraph 4
content: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 above, public entertainments may be subject by law to prior censorship for the sole purpose of regulating access to them for the moral protection of childhood and adolescence.
